title: Jazzy Golden Kenyan Sweet Potato Tagine
description: Rich and snappy, this midnight-craving Kenyan dish features golden caster sugar and nimono-simmer, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal, served on a slate-tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated ginger, cumin, and coriander to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes, golden caster sugar, and 1 cup of water to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
